{{Quote|When a Ranger comes calling, trouble quickly follows.|Tre Sana|<ref name="Dawn of the Jedi: Into the Void">''[[Dawn of the Jedi: Into the Void]]''</ref>}}
'''Je'daii Ranger''' was a rank within the the [[Je'daii Order]]. Rangers were [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitives]] who had completed their studies as [[Je'daii Journeyer|Journeyers]] at each of the [[Je'daii Temples|Great Temples]] of [[Tython/Legends|Tython]] to become full members of the Order. They were tasked with traveling the [[Settled Worlds]] of the [[Tython system/Legends|Tython system]] as the Order's representatives and keepers of the peace.<ref name="DOTJ0" />

==Overview==
A rank within the [[Je'daii Order]], Rangers were members who had successfully trained on [[Tython/Legends|Tython]] and were thus eligible to undertake official missions on behalf of the Order. As representatives of the [[Je'daii Council]], Rangers were the public face of the Order and were stationed across the [[Settled Worlds]] to prevent conflicts and war.<ref name="DOTJ0" />
